name: Fisherman's Style Chilled Lobster Roll on Butter Bun
whyItWorks: Sweet, tender Atlantic lobster claw and knuckle meat tossed in light mayonnaise and served in a soft toasted split-top brioche roll. Pure shellfish protein with low roughage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for light mayonnaise and skip side kettle chips, choosing a soft banana or water instead.
